name: gizza-ai/css-px-to-rem
summary: Convert px lengths in CSS to rem (or back) at any root font size

tool.description: Rewrite a whole CSS/SCSS/LESS stylesheet's px lengths to rem against a configurable root font size — or rem back to px with direction='rem-to-px'. root_font_size (default 16; use 10 for the 62.5% trick) sets what 1rem means; precision (0-10, default 5) caps decimals and trailing zeros are trimmed; properties filters which declarations convert with '*' wildcards and '!' exclusions (default '*' = all); min_pixel_value keeps small values such as 1px borders in px; media_queries (default false) opts breakpoint conditions in; ignore_selectors skips matching rules; keep_fallback emits px and rem declarations as a pair; unitless_zero (default true) writes 0 instead of 0rem. Comments, quoted strings, url(...) payloads and identifiers are preserved byte for byte, and a capitalized unit (16Px) opts a single value out. Runs locally.

css.description: The CSS (or SCSS/LESS) source to rewrite, e.g. ".btn { font-size: 24px; padding: 8px 16px; }". Comments, quoted strings and url(...) payloads are never touched.

direction.description: Which way to convert: 'px-to-rem' divides each px length by root_font_size, 'rem-to-px' multiplies each rem length by it. Default px-to-rem.

ignore_selectors.description: Comma-separated substrings; any rule whose selector (or enclosing selector) contains one is left entirely in its original units, e.g. ".no-rem, #legacy". Empty by default.

keep_fallback.description: Keep the original declaration and append the converted one after it (font-size: 16px; font-size: 1rem;) as a fallback pair, instead of replacing it. Default false.

media_queries.description: Also convert lengths inside @media conditions (e.g. @media (min-width: 640px)). Default false, since breakpoints are usually kept in px.

min_pixel_value.description: Leave lengths whose px magnitude is below this untouched — set 2 to keep 1px hairline borders in px. Applies to the px side in both directions. Default 0 (convert everything).

precision.description: Decimal places kept on each converted number, 0-10. Trailing zeros are always trimmed (0.5000 → 0.5). Default 5.

properties.description: Comma-separated list of CSS properties to convert, with wildcards: '*' = all (default), 'font*' = prefix, '*width' = suffix, '*margin*' = contains, and a leading '!' excludes (e.g. '*,!border*' converts everything except border properties).

root_font_size.description: The root (html) font size in px that 1rem stands for, 1-100. Browsers default to 16; use 10 for the 62.5% (html { font-size: 62.5% }) trick. Default 16.

unitless_zero.description: Write a zero-valued length as a bare 0 rather than 0rem/0px. Default true.
